items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, she’s delightful to work with.

ctx.x: Do you want to talk about your experience with Natalie?
Yeah, she’s delightful to work with. She’s a total professional, comes in, knows everything, just sings like an angel. What more can you ask? She’s very talented.
And a nice person to deal with I’m told.
